newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Svenska Handelsbanken ups Danish 97 GDP.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Svenska Handelsbanken ups Danish 97 GDP.

text.p: In its latest survey Sweden's Svanska Handelsbanken on Monday raised its expectations for Denmark's 1997 GDP (gross domestic product) growth to 3.5 percent from 3.2 percent in its last forecast in November 1996.
At the same time it lowered its estimate for the current account surplus to 0.0 billion crowns from 4.0 billion crowns, reducing its inflation forecast for this year to 2.5 percent from 2.6 percent.

The latest Danish Economy Ministry forecast in December foresaw 2.9 percent GDP growth, 2.3 percent inflation, 8.0 percent unemployment and a current account surplus of 13.0 billion crowns for this year.
The following estimates were made by 10 leading local and international organisations.
